entries.description: Current open/close proxy fills do not model spread, queue, partial fills or liquidity.
entries.resolution: Implement only after BT-GATE-006 closes and BT-GATE-NEXT authorizes a bounded simulator.

entries.description: Borrow availability, locates, locate timing, borrow fees and recalls are absent.
entries.resolution: Open a dedicated short-tradability/borrow gate after core execution semantics.
entries.risk: A mechanically profitable short may be impossible to enter or hold.

entries.description: Applied Architecture may be read as external context and its 09_STATE_CONSUMPTION_BOUNDARY README as a future closed reference. FUTURE_PROVIDER_REGISTRY_INTEGRATION, provider-consumer compatibility, physical StateBundle reads, StateReplayFeed and state-driven execution are not authorized.
entries.resolution: Require an explicit provider-consumer compatibility gate followed by a bounded physical-consumption authorization. Provider progress alone cannot authorize the consumer.
entries.risk: Premature integration could bind the backtester to unstable provider semantics.

entries.description: Preserved runs validate a narrow fixture and one mechanical round trip.
entries.resolution: Expand only after execution semantics and unified run governance close.
entries.risk: Results cannot be generalized to the 2005-2026 universe, performance or edge.
